request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 1000 pcs of bluetooth speaker. The most we are willing to pay: USD 6.22 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Santos. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Evergreen Homeware Factory
Supplier message:
Hello dear,
Thanks for your inquiry about the bluetooth speaker.
Normally USD 7.82/pcs CIF. For this order I can offer USD 7.40 per pcs.
MOQ is 300 pcs.
Delivery time 25 to 30 days after deposit.
Payment: 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment.
Looking forward to your order.
Best regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":7.4,"currency":"USD","moq":300,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":30,"incoterm":"CIF","payment_terms":"30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment"}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Evergreen Homeware team,

Thank you for your quote. USD 7.40 per piece is above what we can accept for this order. We can proceed at USD 6.22 per piece, CIF Santos, for 1000 pcs, no logo printing, packed in export cartons.

Please confirm this price. We also need the following details: your MOQ for this price (we are ordering 1000 pcs), the exact lead time from deposit to shipment, and whether your payment terms and any other conditions (such as packaging, testing or certification) are included in the price.

Looking forward to your confirmation.

Best regards"}
